priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Use Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if Flame Shock is not ticking on the target.
Use Trinkets and Potions during Ascendance, Doom Winds, or while Surging Totem is active.
Cast Sundering if Whirling Earth is active, or to trigger Surging Elements and Feral Spirit.
Use Lava Lash if Whirling Fire or Hot Hand is active.
Use Crash Lightning if the Crash Lightning buff is missing or if Storm Unleashed is talented.
Cast Primordial Storm if you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, or at 5+ stacks if the buff is about to expire.
Cast Ascendance (ideally after a Maelstrom spender to trigger Thorim's Invocation).
Use Windstrike (during Ascendance) or Stormstrike (during Doom Winds) to benefit from Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Lightning Bolt when at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Use Lava Lash as your primary melee filler.
Use Stormstrike and Voltaic Blaze as secondary melee fillers.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 5 or more stacks of Maelstrom Weapon and no higher priority abilities are available.
